stem.text: A mass $m$ is on top of a platform that is supported by gas in a cylinder of cross-sectional area $A$, as shown.

stem.alt: Cylinder containing gas, with a platform carrying a mass labelled m, a height labelled h, and labels platform and gas.

stem.text: The platform has negligible mass and can move freely up and down.
The gas is heated and expands so that the mass is raised through a height $h$. Atmospheric pressure is $p$.
What is the ratio $\dfrac{\text{gain in gravitational potential energy of the mass}}{\text{work done by the gas}}$?
